messages:
Diego R: Heads-up 3 invoice dispute from NovaEdge. They say Dedicated pool was overprovisioned for their pilot (2 GPUs idle most of Jan) and want a retro credit + reduced rate for next quarter.
Priya M: Can you drop the invoice number and the claimed amount? We need concrete ask to evaluate.
Diego R: Invoice INV-2025-1102 total $48,200. They claim $15,600 of dedicated capacity was unused and want 80% credit on that line = $12,480. They propose a 3-month committed discount if we do the credit.
Gabe L: Do we have monitoring to show utilization? Ops ticket helpful.
Diego R: billing-bot: attach monitoring link
billing-bot: <https://internal.redwood.com/ops/mon/POOL-77|POOL-77> 3 utilization graphs attached, and ticket SYS-7721 logged by infra on 2025-01-09.
Eve T: Quick read: pool shows long idle windows 2025-01-05 -> 2025-01-28, average GPU utilization ~22% for that customer's reserved nodes. Worthy of discussion.
Priya M: Deal Desk criteria: 1) Confirmed underutilization 2) Is idle due to our provisioning or customer-side scheduling? 3) Financial impact and precedent. Who owns the provisioning decision?
Gabe L: Infra notes say the pool was provisioned per Sales request (sku "dedicated-small-2"), but customer never enabled autoscale. So partial responsibility on customer, but we also didn't enforce usage check before billing start.
Diego R: Customer says Sales promised a "buffered pool" for pilot. Sales rep (Alyssa) confirmed she advised them to provision two GPUs to avoid throttling.
Priya M: I'm leaning to approve a partial, structured remediation rather than full 80% credit. Suggest: 50% credit on idle portion ($7,800), plus waiver of next-month minimum if they sign a 3-month commitment at 10% discount. Also require SOW amendment in SFDC.
Eve T: Agreed. Also add clause: customer enables autoscale or we provide onboarding session to configure. We should avoid creating an open refund path.
Gabe L: Approver note: Approved one-time credit of $7,800 (50% of disputed line). Conditions: (1) Customer signs 3-month committed usage addendum at 10% discount, (2) Sales to attach SOW amendment to SFDC opportunity #OPP-4592, (3) Finance to post GL ADJ-DED-OVR and issue credit memo CM-2025-2045. Approver: Gabe L.
Diego R: I'll patch invoice comments and request credit memo. billing-bot: please create credit memo flow.
billing-bot: Created CM-2025-2045, status: pending approval. GL: ADJ-DED-OVR.
Priya M: Please capture in Deal Desk tracker and mark as precedent: dedicated pool partial-credit for onboarding configuration misses.
Diego R: Notifying customer of conditional approval and next steps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Eve T: I'll schedule a short onboarding call with NovaEdge ops for autoscale.
Gabe L: Closing loop once credit memo is posted.
